ci_support_linux_64_channel_sourcesconda:
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge,conda-forge/label/python_rc
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
cxx_compiler:
- gxx
cxx_compiler_version:
- '15'
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
pin_run_as_build:
  python:
    min_pin: x.x
    max_pin: x.x
python:
- 3.15.* *_cp315
target_platform:
- linux-64
zip_keys:
- - python
  - channel_sources
name: endf
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.1.12"

package:
  name: endf
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/e/endf/endf-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 97ca1b7a248fcc26c58a9f6a825e48b6643c8a6e111733440ada0ae425d45a68

build:
  number: 2
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - pybind11
  host:
    - python
    - setuptools
    - pybind11
    - setuptools-scm
    - pip
  run:
    - python
    - numpy
    - uncertainties

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - endf
      pip_check: true

about:
  summary: Python interface to ENDF-6 files
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://github.com/paulromano/endf-python
  repository: https://github.com/paulromano/endf-python
  documentation: https://endf-python.readthedocs.io/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - paulromano
    - shimwell
